This is the most detailed practical guide to Grok Bot I could write. 

After more than a month of daily use, I can say it for sure: it's the best AI agent out there. 

I've explored almost every feature, tested a lot of setups, and I have plenty to show. https://t.co/pb0n0hGaL1
